ST Shield Trigger
■ Choose one of the following.
:▶ Your opponent chooses one of their creatures that has the lowest power and puts it into its owner's mana zone. Then they choose one of their creatures that has the highest power and destroy it.
:▶Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Put 2 of them into your mana zone and put the rest into your graveyard.
